7347.title: Question cancellation misattributes lifecycle interruptions to the user
7347.rootCauseOneLine: The question tool distinguishes timeout but maps every other cancellation reason to user dismissal, including plugin disposal.
7347.proposedFix: Preserve explicit user-dismissal and timeout messages; report other cancellation reasons as interruptions without implying a user response or prescribing autonomous continuation.
7347.caveats: Confirmed at the real registered plugin tool boundary using the SDK host harness, including its disposal lifecycle. No real server restart or downstream agent continuation was exercised.
